verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring sends and jobs are a plausible capability for an email-infrastructure API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any scheduling, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. Webhooks and WebSockets are event-driven triggers, not schedules, and the Sim integration describes a third-party workflow platform calling AgentMail rather than AgentMail's own scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
